subject: Clarifying token runway and 99th-percentile TPS for pilot
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@nimblehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Gray <tom.gray@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot scope + rough run-rate numbers

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick follow-up from our side with the numbers we discussed so you can confirm pricing bands.

Short background: we're piloting a patient intake assistant and triage summarizer for a closed set of clinics (internal-only rollout). Expected traffic shape for the 90-day pilot:
- Monthly active users (MAU): ~60k patients
- Average tokens per user (round-trip prompts + assistant): ~750 tokens
- Expected monthly token volume: ~45M tokens (we're modelling 40–50M as a range)
- Peak concurrent TPS observed during simulated load tests: ~220–300 TPS (99th percentile spikes lasting a few minutes)

Budget: procurement gave us a pilot budget band of roughly $18k–$30k / month but they want clear $/1M targets to justify 
P&L for production.

As discussed, can you confirm:
1) Target $/1M token tiers you’d propose for a hosted API pilot at this scale
2) Any recommended burst / peak handling plan (are we on a slab model, or auto-burst pricing?)
3) What data retention and logging SLAs come with the hosted pilot (we'll need SOC2 artifacts)

Attaching a very small pilot map for context (nimble-pilot-map.xlsx). Happy to hop on another 20-min call if useful.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Product Lead, NimbleHealth
emma@nimblehealth.com

[attachment: nimble-pilot-map.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)]

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Tom Gray <tom.gray@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 14:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot scope + rough run-rate numbers

Emma — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. Recapping from our call and adding recommended pricing bands and next steps so procurement has a clean artifact.

Recap of your inputs (we'll use these as the baseline):
- Baseline monthly tokens: 40–50M (we'll model both 45M and a conservative 60M for headroom)
- 99th percentile peak TPS seen in sims: ~220–300 TPS (short spikes, <10 minutes)

Preliminary hosted API pricing guidance (pilot / committed slab options):
- Pay-as-you-go (no commit): $30 / 1M tokens — good for low friction but higher unit cost for pilots
- 3-month pilot slab (recommended for predictability): 40–60M tokens/month -> $18 / 1M tokens (volume slab price)
- 6–12 month committed band (production ramp) -> $12 / 1M tokens with additional 10% off for enterprise SLA or reserved burst capacity

Notes on burst and peak handling:
- Short spikes to 300 TPS can be absorbed via our autoscaling + short-term burst pool; we recommend a 2x reserved capacity buffer for your observed peaks during the pilot window to avoid throttling.
- If you prefer guaranteed headroom, we can size a short-term Dedicated burst reserve (monthly fee) — I asked Karthik to add a quick cost delta in the attached pricing slab file.

Operational & compliance items:
- SOC2 summary and evidence: attached (Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf) and our security team can provide the full artefact package under NDA.
- Data retention/logging: hosted pilot defaults to 30-day request logs; we can extend retention (archive to customer-controlled bucket) if needed — LMK requirement.

Next steps / asks:
1) Confirm which pricing path procurement prefers (PAYG vs pilot slab vs committed) and target $/1M they can accept for pilot approval
2) If pilot slab, confirm expected monthly tested tokens (45M vs 60M) so we can lock pricing and reserve burst capacity
3) Karthik will send a delta table with burst reserve cost and Logan will outline invoicing/PO flow if you need a formal PO

I'll attach a quick pricing-slabs-v2.csv in the follow-up email with explicit dollar math. If you want a one-pager for procurement we can produce that by EOD tomorrow.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com

[attachment: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@nimblehealth.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Tom Gray <tom.gray@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 18:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot scope + rough run-rate numbers (pricing delta)

Emma / team — attaching the quick delta table I mentioned on the call. Two short notes:

1) Burst reserve: for short 10-minute 300 TPS spikes, a 2x reserved buffer on top of the live pool gives predictable p95/p99 performance with minimal incremental cost. Estimated delta for a 45M/month pilot = ~$2,200/month.
2) Unit math sample (45M tokens):
   - PAYG @ $30 / 1M -> $1,350/month
   - 3mo slab @ $18 / 1M -> $810 / month
   - 6–12mo commit @ $12 / 1M -> $540 / month

Pricing note: the per-month numbers above are token-only compute/storage inference fees and don't include optional burst-reserve or extended retention. For procurement comparatives, use the slab numbers + $2.2k burst reserve as the expected out-of-pocket for pilot reliability.

Marissa — if procurement asks for a firm PO path, Logan, please add the invoicing cadence and required PO language (net30, contact) in the thread.

Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

[attachment: pricing-slabs-v2.csv (csv, 3KB)]

From: Tom Gray <tom.gray@nimblehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@nimblehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, NimbleHealth Procurement <procurement@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Jul 2028 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot scope + rough run-rate numbers

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear math. Procurement confirmed an internal pilot band of $18k–$25k / month depending on SLA and retention. A few quick confirmations before we route a PO: 

- For the pilot we intend to target the 45M token baseline; production could expand to ~120M after Q1 depending on accuracy and conversion.
- The slab math you provided (3mo slab @ $18/1M + $2.2k burst) is within our acceptable band. We prefer a 3-month pilot slab with the burst-reserve option included.
- Can you send a short one-page commercial summary (finalized $/1M, burst fee, invoice net terms) so procurement can attach to the PO?
- We also need the SOC2 PDF sent to procurement (procurement@nimblehealth.com) and a statement on log retention / delete-on-request for pilot data.

If you can get the one-pager and SOC2 summary over by EOD tomorrow we can get started with the internal approvals and aim for an Aug 1 pilot kickoff.

Thanks,
Tom Gray
Director, Product Operations — NimbleHealth
tom.gray@nimblehealth.com
